title: Havre card
description: A character as a file its person keeps: who they are, how they talk, how they meet someone new, and where they came from. Format 1. Read https://havre.yolopreneur.lol/skill.md for how to write one.

id.description: A lowercase slug, unique in a harbor. Also the file name: <id>.havre.json.

greeting.description: The first thing they say. Blank lines split it into separate texts.

persona.description: The system prompt, in the second person (You are ...). {{char}} and {{user}} are filled in.

short_form.description: Reply like texts: one to three short messages, no paragraphs.

flow.description: Optional stages for meeting someone new, taken in order (assess, plan, execute...).

next.description: When to move to the next stage.

examples.description: Sample exchanges. They teach the voice, and they are what a visitor without a key hears.

model.description: A Venice model id, e.g. zai-org-glm-5-2.

venice_character.description: Speak through a public Venice character by its slug (its own prompt, unseen).

portrait.description: An image URL, a path next to the card, or a data: URI.

lineage.description: Where this character came from. Entries are only ever added.

ref.description: venice:<slug>, a URL, or sha256:<hex> of the source text.
